Body.Content:
What and why

Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management is increasing the maximum auto-expanding archive capacity for eligible Exchange Online archive mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB. This enhancement helps organizations retain and manage larger volumes of archived email content without requiring manual archive expansion processes or support requests. Eligible mailboxes with auto-expanding archiving enabled will continue to grow automatically as needed.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in mid-October 2026 and expected to complete by late October 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations using Exchange Online archive mailboxes with auto-expanding archiving enabled
  • Administrators responsible for Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management and Exchange Online archiving
  • Users assigned eligible licenses that support the increased archive capacity

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management
  • Exchange Online
  • Exchange Online Archiving

What will happen

  • Eligible archive mailboxes with auto-expanding archiving enabled can automatically expand beyond the current 1.5 TB limit up to a maximum of 3 TB per mailbox.
  • No additional configuration is required for eligible mailboxes that already have auto-expanding archiving enabled.
  • No per-GB consumption charge is introduced as part of this change.
  • Existing archive content, retention configurations, policies, and holds are unchanged.
  • No new administrator workflow, user experience, or user interface is introduced.
  • Mailboxes that do not have an eligible license will continue to be limited to 1.5 TB.

Eligible licensing includes:

  • Office 365 E5, A5, and G5
  • Microsoft 365 E5, A5, and G5
  • Microsoft 365 Purview Suite
  • Microsoft 365 Purview Suite FLW, EDU, and GOV
  • Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW
  • Microsoft 365 F5 Compliance
  • Microsoft 365 F5 Security + Compliance
  • Combination of the eDiscovery & Audit and Insider Risk Management mini suites together with the Information Protection & Governance mini suite

Note: The maximum auto-expanding archive capacity supported through this feature is 3 TB per mailbox for eligible licenses.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required if eligible mailboxes already have auto-expanding archiving enabled.

We recommend that administrators:

  • Review license assignments for users with large archive mailboxes to confirm eligibility.
  • Monitor archive mailbox growth using Exchange Online PowerShell.
  • Identify mailboxes approaching their applicable archive capacity limits.
  • Update internal documentation, retention guidance, and help desk materials to reflect the new 3 TB limit.
  • Review licensing and retention strategies for users whose archive mailboxes are not eligible for the expanded capacity.

Learn more

  • Enable auto-expanding archiving | Microsoft Learn
  • Learn about auto-expanding archiving | Microsoft Learn

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
